items.item_text: High school diploma and / or equivalent certification / experience / training
Experience coordinating human resources practices, policies, & procedures in a large, complex organization.
Experience in listening to, understanding, interpreting and translating spoken or written statements in both English and Spanish.
Experience coordinating recruitment and staffing operations in a large complex organization.
Experience with tracking and maintaining personnel information.
Experience working in a fast-paced & customer-service-driven office environment.

Experience using software such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, e-mail & other computer programs to produce general correspondence, forms, reports, spreadsheets, presentations. Experience creating & managing policies & procedures within a collective bargaining environment.

Under general supervision of the Assistant Director of HR, provide daily administrative & consultative support to department related to departmental compliance, student recruitment & selection, salary actions, coordinating onboarding of new employees and off-boarding of separating employees, and payroll. Serve as a resource to the units on multi-dimensional, complex, & sensitive issues. Liaison with Shared Service Organization (SSO) to resolve key issues related to recruitment, onboarding, payroll & personnel transactions. Provide backup support to Assistant Director & HR Specialists on various Personnel functions. Serve as backup for departmental career recruitment coordinating staff safety training & ensuring compliance with UC policies/procedures.
Skills to use software such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, e-mail & other computer programs to produce general correspondence, forms, reports, spreadsheets, presentations.
Working knowledge of campus policy/procedures and UC systems, such as BANNER, UCPath, Cognos, Handshake, AggieService or other university systems.
Organizational and managerial skills to prioritize, plan and direct workload.
Customer service skills to exercise diplomacy in dealing with others & to resolve potential problems & discrepancies.
Verbal & written communication skills to communicate with a diverse staff & student population.
